patthana18.27:1.1: Saraṇaṃ āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasaraṇo noāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Saraṇaṃ āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naaraṇo noāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Saraṇaṃ āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasaraṇo noāsavo ca naaraṇo noāsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
patthana18.27:2.1: Saraṇaṃ noāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naaraṇo nanoāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.27:3.1: Araṇaṃ sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nasaraṇo nasāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana18.27:4.1: Araṇaṃ anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasaraṇo naanāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ. (Etena upāyena sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ.)
